notes.title: Wizard's Legacy: An Epic Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Wizard's Legacy: An Epic Update![/h1]

[h2]Wizard's Assemble🧙🏻🧙🏻‍♂[/h2]

[b]Wizard's Legacy[/b] has received a major update! The game now features a new enemy that will provide a unique gameplay experience. Additionally, Father, the playable character, has been equipped with a Mace, a powerful new weapon that allows for close-quarters combat. Get ready to embark on a thrilling adventure filled with new challenges and rewards.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2817600/Wizards_Legacy/

[h2]Father's New Weapon: The Mace[/h2]

Father, the formidable boss, has received a significant upgrade! He now wields a powerful Mace, a summonable weapon similar to Tarkan's sword. While the Mace doesn't have spell slots, it serves as a valuable tool for Father to defend himself in close-quarters combat.

Keep in mind that the Mace's damage is relatively low, making it more of a defensive weapon rather than a primary offensive tool.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OMjKh7u.gif[/img]

[h2]Healer Rock: A New Threat[/h2]

Introducing the Healer Rock, a formidable new enemy that poses a unique challenge. This stationary foe constantly heals nearby enemies by firing healing orbs that are visible by green popup numbers.

To defeat the Healer Rock, players must break three crystals attached to its structure using melee weapons or spells. These crystals are strategically placed, requiring careful aiming and tactical planning.

While not essential for completing the arena, eliminating the Healer Rock can significantly reduce the number of enemies you'll face, making the battle easier.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fqqTs57.gif[/img]


[h3]General Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Visual Enhancements[/b]: Fixed flickering and lighting issues in certain scenes.
[*] [b]Gameplay Tweaks[/b]: Adjusted spawn points and improved NPC behavior, including idle animations and voice volume for Vespera.
[*] [b]UI Refinements[/b]: Removed unnecessary UI pointers and added activation buttons to perks for better clarity.
[*][b] Balancing[/b]: Changed item prices and enemy attack prediction for a more balanced economy and challenging gameplay.
[*] [b]Technical Improvements[/b]: Optimized gesture detection and fixed various bugs related to perks, spells, and items.
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Tutorial Enhancements:[/h3]

[list]
[*]  [b]Clarity[/b]: Replaced subtitles with visual instructions for a more engaging tutorial experience.
[*]  [b]Efficiency[/b]: Disabled combo spells early to streamline the learning process.
[/list]

[h3]Spell and Skill Adjustments:[/h3]

[list]
[*]  [b]Visual and Functional Updates:[/b] Improved warding shield effects, fixed flameball explosions, and buffed ground spike damage.
[*]  [b]Rune Spawning:[/b] Adjusted rune spawn settings based on stage level.
[*]  [b]Skill Balance:[/b] Fixed and buffed OranJ perk and Runescription skill.
[/list]

[h3]Bomb Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Power and Utility[/b]: Increased bomb damage, added status effects against bosses, and implemented area explosion damage.
[*] [b]Activation:[/b] Introduced a new activation method by pulling the pin.
[*] [b]Clarity:[/b] Added UI instructions for bomb activation.
[*] 
[/list]

[h3]Boss Improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Visual Updates: [/b]Enhanced Reaper and Borazan shield visuals.
[*] [b]Vulnerabilities:[/b] Made Reaper and Borazan susceptible to Burn, Poison, and Freeze status effects.
[*][b] Impairments:[/b] Slowed down Reaper and Borazan movements, attacks, cooldowns, and ranged attacks when frozen.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rhemKAZ.gif[/img]

These significant changes aim to provide a more immersive, balanced, and engaging experience for players.

notes.title: Wizard's Legacy Patch Notes 0.1.3
notes.content:
[h1]Wizard's Legacy Patch Notes 0.1.3[/h1]

[b]Wizard's Assemble🧙🏻🧙🏻‍♂[/b]

We're excited to announce new patch notes for [b]Wizard's Legacy[/b]! This patch focuses on improving visual clarity, gameplay experience, and bug fixes.

[h2]Visual Enhancements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Spell Rune Clarity: Spell runes now have distinct hover visual effects to easily differentiate between attack (red), utility (blue), and ultimate (yellow) spells.
[*] Borazan Visual Upgrade: Borazan's slash effects have been enhanced with improved visuals for a more impactful look.
[*] Frost Effect Fix: A visual glitch with the frost status effect on enemies has been resolved for Quest 2 and Quest Pro users.
[*] Rune Size Increase: Spell runes have been enlarged for better visibility.
[*] Lobby and Shop Improvements: Locked characters and NPCs in the lobby and shops now have a darker appearance for better distinction.
[*] Boss Health Bars: Boss health bars have been updated with unique designs for each boss and are now always visible.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Gesture Drawing: Added sound effects (SFX) and haptic feedback for gesture drawing.
[*] Warding Shield SFX: Fixed issues with Warding Shield SFX playing incorrectly.
[*] Orange Movement: Fixed an issue with Orange's movement behavior.
[*] Tarkhan Tutorial: Removed the blue screen that occurred after dying and going to the Tarkhan tutorial.
[*] Character Consistency: Fixed inconsistencies between Clockwork OranJ and GrumpyuChickenHead.
[*] Shop UI: Added spell levels to the shop UI for better information.
[*] Enemy Spawning: Fixed an issue that could cause enemies to fall through the environment in the Father tutorial.
[*] We hope you enjoy these improvements! Let us know your thoughts in the comments.
[/list]

Best,
[b]Wide Game Studio[/b]

notes.title: Wizard's Legacy 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Wizards! 🧙‍♂️✨[/h1]
We have just released our first Hotfix Patch for Wizard's Legacy! Firstly, thanks to everyone who bought the game on release day and everyone for their valuable feedback. The major change was improving our gesture recognition algorithm to make it feel much more consistent. 

If you encounter a bug during your gameplay, please report it to our [url=https://discord.gg/nPR8mZAXgr]discord[/url]. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Gesture recognition algorithm improved, highly increasing accuracy and consistency.
[*] UI pointer appear bug fixed.
[*] Lightning bolt wall hanging issue fixed.
[*] Stage 2 boss scene enemy AI navigation issue fixed.
[*] More detailed information about spell usage has been added to the spell description UIs.
[*] HexOCura book perk UI bug fixed.
[*] Fixed the issue with the spell gesture trail staying open between scenes.
[*] Adding functionality to Vespera NPC in shops.
[*] Moved the player's pockets closer to body to decrease chance of accidently picking up items up.
[*] Attack/Combo spells no longer leave the combo phase after shooting or after short time.
[*] Attack/Combo spells are limited to 5 shots/usages per cast.
[*] Lobby chest no longer closes after picking up a rune in pocket.
[*] Removed "Vampire Teeth" perk until further notice.
[/list]
